analysis.reasonEn: Previous 3 trading days maintained a buy decision. Today, RSI at 63.4 remains in neutral territory, and MACD histogram continues to improve at 6.6836. The volume ratio of 0.73 compared to the 5-day average indicates subdued trading volume, suggesting weakening upward momentum. A Higher Low pattern is forming with the 5-day low rising above the 20-day low, but concerns about weakening upward momentum due to lack of volume warrant a wait-and-see approach.
